title: O\'ido: Open-Vocabulary Speech Recognition on a $5 Microcontroller without a Neural Accelerator
abstract: arXiv:2610.13447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech recognition on low-cost microcontrollers is, in practice, limited to keyword spotting or a fixed list of commands. We present O\'ido, an inference engine that runs open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on an ESP32-S3 (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 512 KB of SRAM, 8 MB of PSRAM, 16 MB of flash, no neural accelerator). O\'ido executes a 13M-parameter Conformer-CTC model with int8 weights, per-frame dynamic int8 activations and int8 attention on the chip's SIMD instructions, with a schedule designed around flash and PSRAM bandwidth. On LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other the on-device arithmetic reaches 3.70%/8.23% word error rate (WER), within 0.12 points of full precision, and 3.33%/7.15% with an on-chip 1.3M-parameter language model; a transducer head gives 2.99%/6.67% and an int4 variant fits in 8.3 MB. This is 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer on the same chip, and fewer than Whisper tiny.en and Mo

translated_title: O'ido：在5美元微控制器上实现无需神经加速器的开放词汇语音识别
translated_abstract: 在低成本微控制器上进行语音识别，实际上仅限于关键词检测或固定的命令列表。我们提出了O'ido，这是一个推理引擎，可以在ESP32-S3（240 MHz双核Xtensa LX7、512 KB SRAM、8 MB PSRAM、16 MB闪存、无神经加速器）上完全运行开放词汇英语语音识别。O'ido在芯片的SIMD指令上执行一个1300万参数的Conformer-CTC模型，采用int8权重、逐帧动态int8激活和int8注意力，其调度方案围绕闪存和PSRAM带宽设计。在LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other数据集上，设备端计算达到3.70%/8.23%的词错误率（WER），与全精度相差不到0.12个百分点；配合片上130万参数的语言模型可达3.33%/7.15%；采用转换器（transducer）头则达到2.99%/6.67%，而int4变体可容纳在8.3 MB内。与同一芯片上厂商提供的识别器相比，其错误率降低了2.3-2.8倍，且错误少于Whisper tiny.en和Mo（原文在此处截断）
tldr: O'ido在仅5美元、无神经加速器的ESP32-S3微控制器上实现了开放词汇英语语音识别，通过int8量化和内存带宽优化的调度，错误率比厂商识别器低2.3-2.8倍。
en_tdlr: O'ido achieves open-vocabulary English speech recognition entirely on a $5 ESP32-S3 microcontroller without a neural accelerator, using int8 quantization and bandwidth-aware scheduling to achieve 2.3-2.8x fewer errors than the vendor's recognizer.
